name: Flight of the Hummingbird
source:
Flight of the Hummingbird is a fan game/visual novel made by the Ice Flight for the 2015 Crystalline Gala. You play a Frostbite Hummingbird tasked with the retrieval and delivery of a certain item in time for the Crystalline Gala. Of course, things never go that smoothly, and your travels across Sornieth may turn into quite the adventure...

[From [url=http://www1.flightrising.com/forums/forga/1336671/1]Flight Rising forum thread[/url]]
